changeSet.author: pc
changeSet.comment: The Allocation Visibility dialog no longer offers Faculty see all courses (issue #366), so every recruitment whose allocation_visibility is ALL_COURSES becomes OWN_COURSES, Faculty see their own courses: only QA deployments hold the value, production never has. A one-way data change: nothing records which rows were changed, so the rollback is a no-op and the backend's ALL_COURSES value stays until the cleanup of issue #369.
